text: Now, how this reaches you in an exam. They ask you to draw labelled diagrams, and in June 2024 full marks needed a label or annotation linking the drawing to the supplied example. They ask you to describe and explain the mode of action of a named enzyme, and in the laccase question, full marks needed a reference to laccase or its substrates. For substrate binding, describe complementary shapes. Here is the drawing question. Read it, then watch the credited points land on our model. And the bread? Amylase, extracellular, in your saliva, with an active site complementary to starch; your tongue's cells are not its substrate.
